functions.description: Initialize the PCR module and configure default power domains

functions.description: Get the current power state of a peripheral module

functions.description: Assert or release reset for a specific peripheral module

types.name: clock_domain_t
types.description: Clock domain identifiers for all system clock domains

types.name: pll_config_t
types.description: PLL configuration structure with divider and multiplier values

types.name: clock_source_t
types.description: Available clock sources for domain selection

functions.name: Init
functions.description: Initialize the PLL module with default configuration from SOC description. Configures PLL1 and PLL2, sets up clock domains, and enables oscillator.

functions.name: ConfigurePLL
functions.prototype: pll_status_t PLL_ConfigurePLL(pll_instance_t instance, const pll_config_t* config);
functions.description: Configure a PLL instance with custom multiplier and divider values. Formula: PLLCLK = OSCIN * NF / (NR * R). Application use only, typically not called during init.

functions.name: EnablePLL
functions.description: Enable the specified PLL and wait for lock. Returns PLL_STATUS_OK when locked, PLL_STATUS_TIMEOUT on failure.

functions.name: DisablePLL
functions.description: Disable the specified PLL. System must switch to alternate clock source before disabling.

functions.name: GetLockStatus
functions.description: Check if the specified PLL is locked and stable.

functions.name: GetFrequency
functions.description: Get the current frequency in Hz for a specified clock domain. Returns 0 if domain is invalid or disabled. Used by all peripherals to calculate timing parameters.

functions.name: EnableClock
functions.description: Enable a clock domain. Configures clock source and enables clock distribution. Used by peripherals during initialization.

functions.name: DisableClock
functions.description: Disable a clock domain for power savings. Peripheral must be disabled before calling.

functions.name: SetClockDivider
functions.description: Set the clock divider for a configurable clock domain (VCLK, VCLK2, VCLK3, VCLK4). Divider range 0-15, actual division = divider + 1.

functions.name: GetClockDivider
functions.description: Get the current clock divider setting for a clock domain. Returns 0 if domain has no configurable divider.

functions.name: SelectClockSource
functions.description: Select the clock source for a configurable clock domain. Not all sources are valid for all domains.

functions.name: GetClockSource
functions.description: Get the currently selected clock source for a clock domain.

functions.name: EnableSpreadSpectrum
functions.description: Enable frequency modulation on PLL1 for EMI reduction. Only supported on PLL1, not PLL2.

functions.name: DisableSpreadSpectrum
functions.description: Disable frequency modulation on the specified PLL.

functions.name: WaitForOscillatorValid
functions.description: Wait for the oscillator to stabilize after power-up. Monitors CLKSR0V signal. Timeout in microseconds.

functions.name: GetPLLFrequency
functions.description: Calculate and return the output frequency of the specified PLL in Hz based on current NR, NF, R, and ODPLL settings.

functions.name: EnableClockMonitor
functions.description: Enable clock failure detection for the specified domain using HF_LPO as reference.

functions.name: DisableClockMonitor
functions.description: Disable clock failure detection for the specified domain.

functions.name: ClearClockFailureStatus
functions.description: Clear clock failure status flags in CSVSTAT register.
